title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI Products
body:
## About Orbitane
Orbitane builds an AI workspace for operations teams at 900 companies across Europe.

## What you'll do
- Own features end to end, from the Postgres schema to the React UI
- Build LLM-powered workflows: retrieval, tool use, evaluation
- Work with product and design on what we ship next

## What we're looking for
- 5+ years building web products with TypeScript and React
- Production experience with LLM APIs and retrieval (RAG)
- Strong PostgreSQL skills
- Experience running services on Kubernetes
- You can work from anywhere in Europe

## Nice to have
- Python and FastAPI
- Experience mentoring engineers

title: Staff Machine Learning Platform Engineer
body:
## The role
Fernwick Labs trains forecasting models for energy grids. We need a Staff engineer to lead our ML platform.

## Requirements
- 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in ML infrastructure
- Deep experience with distributed training (PyTorch, Ray)
- Built and operated feature stores and model registries at scale
- Led platform teams of 6+ engineers
- Kubernetes and Terraform in production

## Benefits
- Fully remote across EMEA
- Learning budget

title: Backend Engineer, Payments
body:
## About the job
Tallowmark is building payments infrastructure for marketplaces. This role is on-site in our San Francisco office, five days a week.

## Requirements
- 4+ years of backend development (Node.js or Go)
- Experience with payment systems (Stripe, Adyen)
- PostgreSQL and AWS
- Must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not sponsor visas

## Perks
- Commuter benefits
- Catered lunches

title: Product Engineer, Growth
body:
## Who we are
Quillsby helps small businesses send invoices and get paid faster.

## The role
You'll join the growth team and own experiments across signup, onboarding and billing.

## You have
- 3+ years as a full-stack engineer (React, Node.js)
- Experience running A/B tests and reading the results
- Built onboarding or billing flows with Stripe
- Based in Portugal

## Bonus
- You've shipped an LLM feature to real users

title: AI Engineer
body:
## About us
Brightvale Systems builds document automation for US insurers.

## What you'll do
- Build extraction and summarisation pipelines with LLMs
- Own evaluation and quality metrics for our models

## Requirements
- 4+ years of software engineering in Python or TypeScript
- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG and evaluation
- Remote, but you must be located in the United States

## Benefits
- 401(k) match
- Health, dental and vision

title: Junior Frontend Developer
body:
## The opportunity
A first or second job for a frontend developer who wants to grow with a small agency team.

## Requirements
- 0-2 years of experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
- Some experience with Vue or React
- Eager to learn and take feedback

## What we offer
- Mentoring from senior developers
- Office in central Porto
